# Babysit

> Open-source coding-agent skills and a companion CLI for checkpointed work from a goal through implementation, review and QA. Supports Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity; only Foreman needs Orca.

## Start here

- [README and installation prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/README.md): Value, one copyable install prompt, prerequisites and first-ticket handoff.
- [Installation contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/docs/install.md): Detect the current harness, install CLI plus skills, verify both layers and troubleshoot missing prerequisites.
- [Skill index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/docs/skills.md): Choose a workflow or a directly invocable skill by task.

## Execute and verify

- [Autopilot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/.claude/skills/autopilot/SKILL.md): One ticket on the current checkout; init, plan review, goal handoff and verified local commit.
- [Skill preamble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/.claude/skills/references/preamble.md): Harness-specific invocation, bootstrap, telemetry and escalation contract. Resolve sibling references relative to the installed skill directory.
- [Companion CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/docs/companion-cli.md): CLI commands, durable snapshots and recovery helpers. Skill invocations are agent chat instructions, not CLI subcommands.
- [Foreman](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/docs/foreman.md): Optional Orca-dependent coordination for multi-ticket projects.
- [Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lohi-ai/babysit/main/docs/operations.md): Configuration, progress, evidence, telemetry and health checks.

## Optional
